system.longDesc: With the magic of numbers, you exercise power over the digital world.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Digital Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Digital Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Digital Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Digital Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Digital Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Digital Arcana spells for –1 SP.
